experiment: P9 resampled topology and joint public/response distribution validation
status: development protocol registered; confirmation closed and ungenerated
purpose: replace the legacy six-family equal-weight objective with independently resampled graphs and explicit shifts in public weights and hidden response heterogeneity

public_contract.policy_visibility: r, generator family, repetition and shift labels are environment-only and never passed to the policy

mechanism_gate.communication_update: the public custom-seed environment clips new_w to [-100,100] after every successful communication, including a first action from an initial value outside that interval
mechanism_gate.runner_requirement: abort unless every bounded prediction error in the public probe is zero and at least one unbounded prediction error is nonzero

shift_strata.centered_independent: w scale 1.0 offset 0; r uniform independently in [0.2,1.5]
shift_strata.negative_persona_aligned: w scale 1.25 offset -8; peace r high, neutral middle, violent low
shift_strata.positive_persona_inverse: w scale 0.8 offset +8; peace r low, neutral middle, violent high
shift_strata.wide_degree_positive: w scale 1.6 offset -2; r increases with initial degree plus bounded jitter
shift_strata.compressed_degree_negative: w scale 0.6 offset +2; r decreases with initial degree plus bounded jitter
shift_strata.near_upper_bound: mechanism stress only: map the shared base w sample monotonically into [80,100], retain persona, and draw r independently in [0.2,1.5]
shift_strata.saturated_hubs: mechanism stress only: set the initial-degree top 20 percent to peace persona and w in [90,100], retain other base opinions, and make r increase with initial degree

pairing: for a fixed family and repetition, strata share topology, ID permutation and base persona/opinion draws; each strategy and baseline sees the identical full seed within a pair

development.execution_order: run the two boundary mechanism strata first (16 pairs per arm), then the other five fixed strata (40 pairs per arm)

confirmation.status: reserved; runner requires --confirm and seed_payload requires allow_confirmation
confirmation.open_condition: use only the independently frozen p9-bounded-release protocol after development completion; record source hash before generation

estimands.primary: paired gain averaged equally across the four topology families and seven shifts; also report the original five distribution shifts separately from the two mechanism-stress shifts
estimands.shift_robustness: paired mean gain reported separately for every shift stratum
estimands.topology_robustness: paired mean gain reported separately for every topology family
estimands.behavioral_coverage: fraction of pairs and post-scan decisions whose intervention differs from each control archive

development_selection_rule: complete all 40 declared pairs for every arm and control
rank by primary paired mean against the official-best historical experimental control
require nonnegative paired mean in each of the seven shift strata against that control
report every topology mean and loss without retrospective exclusions
reject arms with action failures, budget violations, step violations or incomplete logs
use v9 and P8 comparisons for attribution; they do not replace the official-best control
required_run_log: ordered action attempts with kind, public targets, prompt_id, success and budget before/after
public communication response returned by the environment
final score, remaining budget, action counts, step count and stop reason
LLM attempts, accepted decisions, fallbacks and transport errors
P8/P9 proposals, selected proposal/baseline counts and planning error class counters when available
first intervention divergence from every control archive
resource_gate: every action validates public node/edge/prompt/budget constraints before dispatch; environment return is the only factual update
confirmation_gate: preregister separately after development winner freeze; confirmation data must not tune candidates or thresholds
